diff --git a/lib/numwords.rb b/lib/numwords.rb
index 6946ba9..e73dd3b 100644
--- a/lib/numwords.rb
+++ b/lib/numwords.rb
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@ module NumWords
 
   module_function
 
-  # to_words(0) => "zero", to_words(42) => "forty-two", to_words(1_205) => "one thousand two hundred five"
+  # to_words(0) => "zero", to_words(42) => "forty-two", to_words(1_205) => "one thousand two hundred and five"
   # Numbers up to 999_999; negatives get a "minus " prefix.
   def to_words(n)
     raise ArgumentError, 'integer expected' unless n.is_a?(Integer)
@@ -17,30 +17,39 @@ module NumWords
     parts = []
     thousands, rest = n.divmod(1000)
     parts << "#{below_thousand(thousands)} thousand" if thousands.positive?
-    parts << below_thousand(rest) if rest.positive?
+    parts << below_thousand(rest, last: thousands.positive?) if rest.positive?
     parts.join(' ')
   end
 
-  def below_thousand(n)
+  def below_thousand(n, last: false)
     words = []
     hundreds, rest = n.divmod(100)
     words << "#{ONES[hundreds]} hundred" if hundreds.positive?
     if rest >= 20
       tens, ones = rest.divmod(10)
-      words << (ones.zero? ? TENS[tens] : "#{TENS[tens]} #{ONES[ones]}")
+      words << (ones.zero? ? TENS[tens] : "#{TENS[tens]}-#{ONES[ones]}")
     elsif rest.positive?
       words << ONES[rest]
     end
+    if words.size == 2
+      words[1] = "and #{words[1]}"
+    elsif last && words.size == 1
+      words[0] = "and #{words[0]}"
+    end
     words.join(' ')
   end
 
   # Ordinal suffix: 1 => "1st", 12 => "12th", 23 => "23rd".
   def ordinal(n)
-    suffix = case n % 10
-             when 1 then 'st'
-             when 2 then 'nd'
-             when 3 then 'rd'
-             else 'th'
+    suffix = case n % 100
+             when 11, 12, 13 then 'th'
+             else
+               case n % 10
+               when 1 then 'st'
+               when 2 then 'nd'
+               when 3 then 'rd'
+               else 'th'
+               end
              end
     "#{n}#{suffix}"
   end
result.summary: Fixed lib/numwords.rb (tests untouched). Three bugs: (1) below_thousand joined tens+ones with a space instead of a hyphen — now "forty-two" (lib/numwords.rb:30); (2) "and" was never emitted — now inserted between "hundred" and the remainder in any group, and prepended to the last group when it has no hundreds (e.g. "two thousand and one"), gated on thousands.positive? so numbers < 1000 stay plain (lib/numwords.rb:20,35-39); (3) ordinal() used only n % 10, giving "11st" — now checks n % 100 for 11/12/13 → "th" first, then n % 10 for st/nd/rd (lib/numwords.rb:44-53). Verified: `ruby -Ilib -Itest test/all_test.rb` → 6 runs, 22 assertions, 0 failures, exit 0.
